scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend-node && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ,backend-csharp,frontend,app -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "dotnet run --project backend-csharp" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix app"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -n ,backend-node,frontend,app -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend-node" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix app"
scripts.build: dotnet publish backend-csharp && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix app
scripts.build:node: npm run build --prefix backend-node && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix app
